name: MAG Holdings Berhad
overview: 根据所提供的公告，MAG Holdings Berhad 在 2026 年没有发布任何关于业务板块扩张、新增、缩减、出售或获得合约的公告。公告主要涉及季度业绩、股东大会、年报及委员会成员变动。
overview_en: Based on the announcements provided, MAG Holdings Berhad did not release any announcements in 2026 regarding business segment expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract wins. The announcements mainly cover quarterly results, general meetings, annual reports, and changes in committee memberships.
